remarks: Located in the established southwest Edmonton community of MacEwan, this top-floor, 1-bedroom condo offers just over 645 sq ft of comfortable living space in a well-situated building constructed in 2005. The functional layout includes a spacious living area, a comfortable bedroom, and a full 4-piece bathroom. An east-facing balcony provides generous outdoor space to enjoy the morning sun. Also included is one titled underground parking stall and an exclusive-use storage unit for added convenience. Residents have access to a fitness room and social room on the main floor, along with a secured building entrance. MacEwan offers convenient access to shopping, restaurants, parks, and walking trails, with nearby Anthony Henday Drive and Calgary Trail making it easy to get around the city. A practical, low-maintenance home in a connected south Edmonton neighbourhood. Some photos have been digitally staged. (id:67522)
